definitions.explanation: A particular way or system of doing something.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
{日本式|にほんしき}の{庭|にわ}が{好|す}きだ。
{入学式|にゅうがくしき}は{四月|しがつ}です。
examples.english: The entrance ceremony is in April.

notes:
〜{式|しき} is a suffix with two main meanings: (1) ceremony/ritual, and (2) style/type/method.

CEREMONIES:
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}: wedding ceremony
- {入学式|にゅうがくしき}: entrance ceremony
- {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}: graduation ceremony
- {開会式|かいかいしき}: opening ceremony
- {閉会式|へいかいしき}: closing ceremony

STYLES/TYPES:
- {日本式|にほんしき}: Japanese-style
- {西洋式|せいようしき}: Western-style
- {新式|しんしき}: new style
- {旧式|きゅうしき}: old style

OTHER USES:
- {数式|すうしき}: mathematical formula
- {方程式|ほうていしき}: equation
